mode.description: The mode of operation: server, ping-pong, throughput, under-load, or playback.

role.description: The role of the sockperf instance: server or client.

ip.description: The IP address to listen on or send to. Leave empty for default.

port.description: The port number to listen on or connect to.

tcp.description: Use TCP protocol instead of UDP.

iomux_type.description: Type of multiple file descriptors handle: s/select, p/poll, e/epoll, r/recvfrom, x/socketxtreme.

buffer_size.description: Set total socket receive/send buffer size in bytes. 0 for system default.

recv_looping_num.description: Loop over recvfrom() until EAGAIN or N good received packets. -1 for infinite.

dontwarmup.description: Don't send warm up messages on start.

pre_warmup_wait.description: Time to wait before sending warm up messages in seconds.

threads_num.description: Run N threads on server side (requires '-f' option).

cpu_affinity.description: Set threads affinity to the given core ids in list format.

msg_size_server.description: Maximum message size that the server can receive in bytes. 0 for default.

force_unicast_reply.description: Force server to reply via unicast.

dont_reply.description: Server won't reply to the client messages.

msg_size_client.description: Use messages of size N bytes. 0 for default.

burst.description: Control the client's number of messages sent in every burst. 0 for default.

mps.description: Set number of messages-per-second. 0 for default (max for ping-pong/throughput).

range_size.description: Randomly change the messages size in range: <size> +- N.

srv_num.description: Set num of servers the client works with to N.

sender_affinity.description: Set sender thread affinity to the given core ids in list format.

receiver_affinity.description: Set receiver thread affinity to the given core ids in list format.

full_log.description: Dump full log of all messages send/receive time to the given file in CSV format.

full_log_file.description: Path to the full log file if full_log is enabled.

client_port.description: Force the client side to bind to a specific port. 0 for default.

client_ip.description: Force the client side to bind to a specific ip address. Empty for default.

playback_file.description: Path to the playback file if mode is playback.

tcp_avoid_nodelay.description: Stop/Start delivering TCP Messages Immediately (Enable/Disable Nagle).

no_rdtsc.description: Don't use register when taking time; instead use monotonic clock.
